Devin (Sales): Priya's security team just sent a formal ask: they need a data residency diagram scoped to EU regions, a signed subprocessor list (current + last 12 months), and POC packaging details for a potential on-prem / VPC deployment. Deadline end of week.

Jamie (Solutions Eng): Got it. Do they want a hosted flow with EU-only compute or the private deployment diagram? We should clarify because the artifacts differ.

Priya (Customer CISO): Hi team — we need both high-level hosted flow (to check cross-border risks) and a private/VPC schematic showing network boundaries. Also please include KMS key handling and audit log retention.

Devin (Sales): @Jamie @Morgan prioritized: hosted EU-only + private VPC diagram. Also need a checklist for POC handoff (what we deliver, what customer needs to provide).

Morgan (Security): I'll handle the subprocessor list. We can provide a signed PDF list plus CSV. For KMS, note that Hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS (we can do CMEK on Dedicated/Private). For Private we support customer KMS via BYOK/HSM integration.

Jamie (Solutions Eng): Drafting diagrams now. Quick ASCII sketch for hosted EU-only flow (will export nicer SVG for them):

```
Browser / App -> Public API (gateway.eu.redwood.ai)
                     |
                 Load Balancer
                     |
           Inference Runtime (eu-west-1)
           /         |         \\\
Model KV cache  ->  GPU pool   ->  Object Store (eu-west-1 S3)
                     |
                 Audit Logs -> Log Storage (retained 90d)
```

Jamie (Solutions Eng): For Private/VPC POC we need to show: control plane (region-agnostic, minimal metadata) vs customer data plane fully inside customer's VPC.

```
Customer VPC (subnet A) -> Private Runtime (in customer subnet)
                         -> Model weights stored in customer-controlled S3
                         -> KMS (customer-owned) for encryption
                         -> Audit logs forwarded to customer's SIEM
```

Morgan (Security): Subprocessors (short list) we will include in signed artifact:
- cloud-provider-eu (infrastructure)
- object-storage-vendor (S3-compatible)
- telemetry/observability-vendor (logs only, redacted)
- monitoring-agent-vendor (agent delivery)

Morgan (Security): Note: For Private customers, we can remove telemetry vendor access if they request fully air-gapped. Also we can provide pseudonymization guidance (we don't persist PII in model KV unless configured).

Ana (Legal): I'll prepare a short attestation we can sign: includes statement of current subprocessors, change notification window (30 days), and SOC2+GDPR compliance references. We should avoid bespoke legal terms until sales outside standard EULA.

Priya (Customer CISO): For the hosted diagram, can you confirm whether prefix/KV caching ever leaves EU region? They need explicit confirmation that cache replicas aren't in US.

Jamie (Solutions Eng): Confirmed: for EU-hosted tier we pin compute and KV caches to EU regions only. We will include a note about cross-region fallback policy: if EU capacity is exhausted, the policy is to fail closed for customers with residency requirement unless they opt into multi-region failover. We'll include the exact registry flags we set.

Devin (Sales): Action items: Jamie -> export SVG + PNG diagrams + short 1-page POC checklist; Morgan -> signed subprocessor CSV + PDF; Ana -> signable attestation; Jamie & Morgan -> short answers to the two CISO Qs (KMS, cache residency). Delivery target: Thursday EOD. Priya, is that acceptable?

Priya (Customer CISO): Thursday EOD works. Also can you include a sample network ACL snippet we recommend for Private deployment?

Jamie (Solutions Eng): Yep. Example ACL snippet for inbound from customer app to runtime: 
```
- allow tcp 443 from CUSTOMER_APP_CIDR to PRIVATE_RUNTIME_CIDR
- deny 0.0.0.0/0 to PRIVATE_RUNTIME_CIDR
```

Morgan (Security): I'm going to redact non-essential subprocessors from the public doc and provide the full list under NDA if they need more. Also will include retention windows: logs 90 days (hosted), audit trail 1 year (managed), option for longer via enterprise add-on.

Devin (Sales): I'll send a handoff email after we assemble artifacts. Tagging owners on tasks: @Jamie (SVG + checklist), @Morgan (subproc + retention table), @Ana (attestation).

Ana (Legal): One more ask: Priya, do you need us to sign an Appendix for Data Processing Agreement changes or is standard DPA sufficient?

Priya (Customer CISO): Standard DPA + subprocessor list is fine for now. If POC moves to a contract we'll escalate to Appendix.

Jamie (Solutions Eng): Will upload diagrams + checklist to this thread when ready. ETA 6 hours.

Morgan (Security): I'll drop the signed CSV by EOD and DM procurement contact for NDA.

Devin (Sales): Thanks team :thumbsup: — will keep Priya looped.

Priya (Customer CISO): Thanks, appreciate the speed.
